about: Real Vercel AI SDK v5 spans from its own experimental_telemetry (the ai.* dialect: ai.generateText, ai.generateText.doGenerate, ai.toolCall ...). Recorded through a scripted fetch with an AsyncLocalStorage context manager and deterministic clocks: no network, no API keys, no rius SDK. The rius SDK translates these through @arizeai/openinference-vercel's transform before normalizing; the expected-result tool runs the same chain.

scenarios.generate_text: generateText with a system prompt, temperature and maxOutputTokens.
scenarios.tool_loop: generateText with one tool and stopWhen: stepCountIs(2): two model calls (24/51 then 91/15 tokens) with the tool executed between them.
scenarios.embed: embed with text-embedding-3-small; the response vector is three floats.

vercel-ai-v5-5.0.273.json.verified: Re-recorded 2026-10-12 several times in a row from the lockfile's node_modules: byte-identical.
